# Third-party asset packs

All CC0 (public domain), chosen by the owner (see docs/art_direction.md).
Curated: only what fits the setting, textures reduced to at most 256 px and
opaque textures palettized to 256 colours. Full packs can be re-downloaded
with `tools/art/fetch_itch_pack.sh owner/game`.

| Folder | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| elegantcrow_psx_trees | https://elegantcrow.itch.io/psx-retro-style-tree-pack | |
| elegantcrow_psx_nature | https://elegantcrow.itch.io/retro-psx-nature-pack | trees, bushes (glTF) |
| elbolilloduro_vegetation | https://elbolilloduro.itch.io/vegetation | one FBX + textures |
| elbolilloduro_mine | https://elbolilloduro.itch.io/mine | re-texture rocks and beams with varied textures (owner) |
| elbolilloduro_psx_models_2 | https://elbolilloduro.itch.io/paquete-de-modelos-low-poly-estilo-psx-2 | one FBX; skip modern objects |
| valsekamerplant_walls | https://valsekamerplant.itch.io/psx-style-walls-fences | chain-link, picket, placard walls dropped |
| sbs_tiny_texture_pack_3 | https://screamingbrainstudios.itch.io/tiny-texture-pack-3 | 256 px set; metal, grating, gem, tech dropped |
| sbs_noise_texture_pack | https://screamingbrainstudios.itch.io/noise-texture-pack | 128 px; for blending and colour variation |
| foxtex | https://foxh3ad.itch.io/foxtexcom | Stone, Wood, Outdoors, Water only; no concrete, metal, lights, modern brick |
